title: Quick Cheesy Venezuelan Chuck Roast Bowl
description: A midnight-craving bowl of jammy, cheese-pull roasted chuck with vibrant Venezuelan flavors, served in a Korean brass bowl for a dramatic finish.
instructions: Heat the robata grill to medium-high and brush the grates with olive oil.
Season the chuck cubes with black pepper, smoked paprika, cumin, oregano, and minced garlic.
Place the seasoned cubes onto the grill and sear each side until brown, about 2 minutes per side.
Add sliced bell pepper, onion, and canned diced tomatoes to the grill, cooking until vegetables are softened, about 5 minutes.
Transfer the roast and vegetables onto a preheated Korean brass bowl.
Pour 1/4 cup water over the contents to create steam and help melt the cheeses.
Sprinkle shredded mozzarella evenly over the top and cover the bowl with a lid or foil to trap heat.
Cook for an additional 5 minutes, or until the cheese melts and pulls into a creamy blanket.
Serve immediately, letting the cheese pull form a glossy topping that guests can spoon over each bite.
Optional: squeeze a dash of lime juice before serving for brightness.
